name: calculator
description: Advanced calculator for math, statistics, and unit conversions. Use for: arithmetic (2+2, 5^3, sqrt(144)), percentages (15% of 200, what percent is 30 of 200), statistics (mean of 1,2,3,4,5, stdev, median, mode, variance), unit conversions (5 miles to km, 100 fahrenheit to celsius, 2 cups to ml, 500 gb to tb), trigonometry (sin, cos, tan - use sind/cosd/tand for degrees), logarithms (log, log10, ln), and special functions (factorial, gcd, lcm). Constants available: pi, e, tau. Example: 'sqrt(144) + 5^2' returns 37.

expression.description: The calculation to perform. Can be: math expression (2+2, 5^3, sqrt(144)), percentage (15% of 200), unit conversion (5 miles to km), or statistics (mean of 1,2,3,4,5)

type.description: Type hint for parsing. Usually 'auto' works best.
